description: This file defines a Kivy UI component 'Popup' for creating modal popup windows, including class definitions, properties, and example usage code.

classes.name: PopupException
classes.description: Custom exception class for Popup-related errors, raised when multiple content widgets are added.

classes.name: Popup
classes.description: A modal popup widget class inheriting from ModalView, with properties for title, content, styling, and event handling.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Overrides add_widget to set the content of the popup, ensuring only one content widget.

methods.name: on_content
methods.description: Updates the internal container when the content property changes.

methods.name: on__container
methods.description: Synchronizes the container widget with the content property.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch events, preventing interaction if the popup is disabled.
